resources.zfs-syncoid-abort-partial-receive.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Abort any partial ZFS receive on a target dataset (and optionally its descendants).
# Usage: zfs-syncoid-abort-partial-receive.sh <target_dataset> [recursive]
#
# Exit 0 always — partial receives that are aborted are logged, datasets
# without a pending receive are silently skipped.

log_tag="zfs-syncoid-abort-partial"
target="${1:-}"
recursive="${2:-false}"

if [[ -z "${target}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Usage: ${0} <target_dataset> [recursive]"
  exit 1
fi

abort_if_pending() {
  local ds="${1}"
  # zfs get -H -o value receive_resume_token returns "-" when there is no
  # pending receive, and a base64 token string when there is one.
  local token
  token="$(zfs get -H -o value receive_resume_token "${ds}" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")"
  if [[ "${token}" != "-" && -n "${token}" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Aborting partial receive on ${ds}"
    local abort_output abort_rc
    abort_output="$(zfs receive -A "${ds}" 2>&1)" && abort_rc=0 || abort_rc=$?
    if [[ ${abort_rc} -eq 0 ]]; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Successfully aborted partial receive on ${ds}"
    else
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "WARNING: zfs receive -A on ${ds} exited ${abort_rc}: ${abort_output}"
    fi
  fi
}

if [[ "${recursive}" == "true" ]]; then
  # Process the target and all descendants
  while IFS= read -r ds; do
    abort_if_pending "${ds}"
  done < <(zfs list -r -H -o name "${target}" 2>/dev/null || echo "${target}")
else
  abort_if_pending "${target}"
fi

set -euo pipefail

unit_name="${1:-unknown}"

resources.zfs-syncoid-prune-conflicts.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

source_dataset="${1:-}"
target_dataset="${2:-}"
recursive="${3:-false}"
prune_target_only="${4:-false}"
log_tag="zfs-syncoid-prune"

if [[ -z "${source_dataset}" || -z "${target_dataset}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Usage: ${0} <source_dataset> <target_dataset>"
  exit 1
fi

if ! zfs list -H -o name "${target_dataset}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Target dataset ${target_dataset} not found; skipping."
  exit 0
fi

_is_true() {
  case "${1}" in
    1|true|TRUE|True|yes|YES|on|ON) return 0 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

# Process a single source/target dataset pair:
#   1. Destroy GUID-conflicting snapshots (same name, different GUID)
#   2. If prune_target_only is true, destroy target-only snapshots that are
#      NEWER than the most recent common snapshot.  Older target-only snapshots
#      are preserved — they may be needed by other replication chains (e.g. USB
#      offsite sync) as common-snapshot anchors.
_process_dataset() {
  local src_ds="${1}" tgt_ds="${2}"

  mapfile -t tgt_snaps < <(zfs list -t snapshot -H -o name -s creation "${tgt_ds}" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [[ ${#tgt_snaps[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    return
  fi

  # --- pass 1: find last common snapshot index & destroy GUID conflicts ------
  local last_common_idx=-1
  local -a guid_conflicts=()
  for i in "${!tgt_snaps[@]}"; do
    local snap_name="${tgt_snaps[$i]#*@}"
    local src_snap="${src_ds}@${snap_name}"

    if zfs list -t snapshot -H -o name "${src_snap}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      local src_guid tgt_guid
      src_guid="$(zfs get -H -o value guid "${src_snap}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      tgt_guid="$(zfs get -H -o value guid "${tgt_snaps[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if [[ -n "${src_guid}" && -n "${tgt_guid}" && "${src_guid}" != "${tgt_guid}" ]]; then
        guid_conflicts+=("${tgt_snaps[$i]}")
      else
        last_common_idx="${i}"
      fi
    fi
  done

  # Destroy GUID conflicts
  for snap in "${guid_conflicts[@]+"${guid_conflicts[@]}"}"; do
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Destroying conflicting snapshot ${snap}"
    if ! zfs destroy "${snap}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Failed to destroy ${snap}"
    fi
  done

  # --- pass 2: prune target-only snapshots newer than last common snapshot ---
  if _is_true "${prune_target_only}" && [[ ${last_common_idx} -ge 0 ]]; then
    for i in "${!tgt_snaps[@]}"; do
      # Skip snapshots at or before the last common snapshot
      if [[ "${i}" -le ${last_common_idx} ]]; then
        continue
      fi

      local snap_name="${tgt_snaps[$i]#*@}"
      local src_snap="${src_ds}@${snap_name}"

      # Only prune if this snapshot does not exist on the source
      if ! zfs list -t snapshot -H -o name "${src_snap}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        logger -t "${log_tag}" "Destroying target-only snapshot ${tgt_snaps[$i]} (newer than last common)"
        if ! zfs destroy "${tgt_snaps[$i]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          logger -t "${log_tag}" "Failed to destroy ${tgt_snaps[$i]}"
        fi
      fi
    done
  elif _is_true "${prune_target_only}" && [[ ${last_common_idx} -lt 0 ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "No common snapshot found for ${tgt_ds}; skipping target-only pruning"
  fi
}

# Enumerate datasets to process
if _is_true "${recursive}"; then
  mapfile -t target_datasets < <(zfs list -r -H -o name "${target_dataset}" 2>/dev/null || echo "${target_dataset}")
else
  target_datasets=("${target_dataset}")
fi

for tgt_ds in "${target_datasets[@]}"; do
  suffix="${tgt_ds#${target_dataset}}"
  src_ds="${source_dataset}${suffix}"
  _process_dataset "${src_ds}" "${tgt_ds}"
done

resources.zfs-syncoid-spindown.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

pool="tank"
spindown_device_count=1
spindown_retries=10
spindown_sleep_sec=60

spindown_devices=(
  "/dev/disk/by-id/owned"
)

if [[ -n "${pool}" ]]; then
  if command -v zpool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    attempt=0
    while true; do
      stats=$(zpool iostat -H -p "${pool}" 1 2 | tail -n 1 || true)
      if [[ -n "${stats}" ]]; then
        read -r _pool _alloc _free read_ops write_ops read_bytes write_bytes <<<"${stats}"
        if [[ "${read_ops:-0}" != "0" || "${write_ops:-0}" != "0" || "${read_bytes:-0}" != "0" || "${write_bytes:-0}" != "0" ]]; then
          if [[ "${attempt}" -ge "${spindown_retries}" ]]; then
            logger -t zfs-syncoid-spindown "Pool ${pool} active (r=${read_ops:-0} w=${write_ops:-0} rb=${read_bytes:-0} wb=${write_bytes:-0}); giving up after ${attempt} retries."
            exit 0
          fi
          attempt=$((attempt + 1))
          logger -t zfs-syncoid-spindown "Pool ${pool} active (r=${read_ops:-0} w=${write_ops:-0} rb=${read_bytes:-0} wb=${write_bytes:-0}); retrying in ${spindown_sleep_sec}s (attempt ${attempt}/${spindown_retries})."
          sleep "${spindown_sleep_sec}"
          continue
        fi
      fi
      break
    done
  fi
fi

if [[ "${spindown_device_count}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  logger -t zfs-syncoid-spindown "No spindown devices configured; skipping."
  exit 0
fi

for dev in "${spindown_devices[@]}"; do
  if [[ -b "${dev}" ]]; then
    if ! hdparm -y "${dev}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      logger -t zfs-syncoid-spindown "hdparm failed for ${dev}"
    fi
  else
    logger -t zfs-syncoid-spindown "Device ${dev} not found; skipping."
  fi
done

resources.zfs-usb-replication.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="zfs-usb-replication"
pool="vault"
key_path="/root/.zfs-key-vault"
syncoid_bin="/usr/sbin/syncoid"
force_export="false"
spindown_enabled="true"
spindown_script="/usr/local/bin/zfs-usb-spindown.sh"
state_path="/var/lib/zfs-usb-replication/status.json"
state_writer="/usr/local/bin/zfs_usb_replication_state.py"
retention_script="/usr/local/bin/zfs_usb_snapshot_retention.py"
exportfs_lock_dir="/etc/exports.d"
set_canmount_off_for_readonly_recursive_targets="true"
anchor_helper="/usr/local/bin/zfs_usb_bookmark_anchors.py"
anchor_state_path="/var/lib/zfs-usb-replication/anchors.json"

# Drives of the offsite rotation. They share one pool name, so each present
# drive is imported, replicated and exported on its own.
device_names=(
  "owned-a"
  "owned-b"
)
device_paths=(
  "/dev/disk/by-id/owned-a"
  "/dev/disk/by-id/owned-b"
)
device_pool_guids=(
  "1234"
  ""
)

# write_state RESULT EXIT_CODE DEVICE_INDEX|"" [writer args...]
write_state() {
  local result="$1"
  local exit_code="$2"
  local index="$3"
  shift 3
  local -a device_args=()
  if [[ -n "${index}" ]]; then
    device_args=(--device-path "${device_paths[$index]}")
    if [[ -n "${device_names[$index]}" ]]; then
      device_args+=(--device-name "${device_names[$index]}")
    fi
  else
    device_args=(--device-path "$(IFS=,; echo "${device_paths[*]}")")
  fi
  if [[ -x "${state_writer}" ]]; then
    if ! "${state_writer}" \
      --state-path "${state_path}" \
      --result "${result}" \
      --exit-code "${exit_code}" \
      --pool "${pool}" \
      "${device_args[@]}" \
      "$@"; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Failed to persist USB replication state (${result})"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "USB replication state writer not executable: ${state_writer}"
    return 1
  fi
}

device_label() {
  local index="$1"
  if [[ -n "${device_names[$index]}" ]]; then
    printf '%s (%s)' "${device_names[$index]}" "${device_paths[$index]}"
  else
    printf '%s' "${device_paths[$index]}"
  fi
}

# Print the -d arguments that restrict a pool import to one drive, so a second
# attached drive carrying the same pool name can never be picked up instead.
import_search_args() {
  local device="$1"
  local found=false
  local member
  for member in "${device}"-part*; do
    if [[ -e "${member}" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "-d" "${member}"
      found=true
    fi
  done
  if [[ "${found}" != "true" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "-d" "${device}"
  fi
}

pool_imported() {
  zpool list -H -o name 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "${pool}"
}

# True when the imported pool has a vdev on this drive (whole disk or one of
# its partitions), compared by resolved device node.
pool_on_device() {
  local device="$1"
  local device_real vdev vdev_real
  device_real="$(readlink -f "${device}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "${device_real}" ]] || return 1
  while IFS= read -r vdev; do
    [[ "${vdev}" == /* ]] || continue
    vdev_real="$(readlink -f "${vdev}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "${vdev_real}" == "${device_real}" || "${vdev_real}" =~ ^${device_real}p?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      return 0
    fi
  done < <(zpool list -v -H -P "${pool}" 2>/dev/null | awk -F'\t' '{print $2}')
  return 1
}

# Runs in its own subshell per drive. Its variables are deliberately not local:
# the EXIT trap (finish) runs after the function returned and still needs them.
replicate_device() {
  index="$1"
  device="${device_paths[$index]}"
  expected_guid="${device_pool_guids[$index]}"
  label="$(device_label "${index}")"
  pool_preexisting=false
  observed_guid=""
  signal_exit_code=0

  handle_signal() {
    signal_exit_code="$1"
    exit "${signal_exit_code}"
  }
  finish() {
    local exit_code=$?
    if [[ ${signal_exit_code} -ne 0 ]]; then
      exit_code=${signal_exit_code}
    fi
    local -a usage_args=()
    local export_failed=false
    trap - EXIT
    if pool_imported && pool_on_device "${device}"; then
      local usage_line
      usage_line=$(zpool list -Hp -o size,alloc,free "${pool}" 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [[ -n "${usage_line}" ]]; then
        local size_bytes alloc_bytes free_bytes
        IFS=$'\t' read -r size_bytes alloc_bytes free_bytes <<< "${usage_line}"
        if [[ "${size_bytes}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "${alloc_bytes}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "${free_bytes}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
          usage_args=(
            --size-bytes "${size_bytes}"
            --alloc-bytes "${alloc_bytes}"
            --free-bytes "${free_bytes}"
          )
        fi
      fi
      if [[ "${pool_preexisting}" == "true" && "${force_export}" != "true" ]]; then
        :
      else
        logger -t "${log_tag}" "Exporting pool ${pool} from ${label}"
        zfs unmount -r "${pool}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        if ! zpool export "${pool}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          export_failed=true
          logger -t "${log_tag}" "Failed to export pool ${pool} from ${label}"
        fi
      fi
    fi
    if [[ -n "${observed_guid}" ]]; then
      usage_args+=(--pool-guid "${observed_guid}")
    fi
    if [[ "${export_failed}" == "true" && ${exit_code} -eq 0 ]]; then
      exit_code=1
    fi
    if [[ ${exit_code} -eq 0 ]]; then
      if ! write_state "success" 0 "${index}" "${usage_args[@]}"; then
        exit_code=1
      fi
    else
      write_state "failed" "${exit_code}" "${index}" "${usage_args[@]}" || true
    fi
    exit "${exit_code}"
  }
  trap finish EXIT
  trap 'handle_signal 129' HUP
  trap 'handle_signal 130' INT
  trap 'handle_signal 143' TERM

  if pool_imported; then
    if ! pool_on_device "${device}"; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Pool ${pool} is already imported from another device; cannot replicate to ${label}"
      exit 1
    fi
    pool_preexisting=true
  else
    local -a search_args=()
    mapfile -t search_args < <(import_search_args "${device}")
    if [[ -n "${expected_guid}" ]]; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Importing pool ${pool} (guid ${expected_guid}) from ${label}"
      zpool import "${search_args[@]}" -o cachefile=none "${expected_guid}"
    else
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Importing pool ${pool} from ${label}"
      zpool import "${search_args[@]}" -o cachefile=none "${pool}"
    fi
  fi

  observed_guid=$(zpool get -H -o value guid "${pool}" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [[ -n "${expected_guid}" && "${observed_guid}" != "${expected_guid}" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Pool ${pool} on ${label} has guid ${observed_guid}, expected ${expected_guid}; refusing to replicate"
    exit 1
  fi

  keystatus=$(zfs get -H -o value keystatus "${pool}" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [[ "${keystatus}" != "available" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Loading key for pool ${pool}"
    zfs load-key -L "file://${key_path}" "${pool}"
  fi

  mkdir -p "${exportfs_lock_dir}"

  if [[ "${set_canmount_off_for_readonly_recursive_targets}" == "true" ]]; then
    :
    if zfs list -H -o name "tank/owned" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      job_canmount=$(zfs get -H -o value canmount "tank/owned" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
      job_readonly=$(zfs get -H -o value readonly "tank/owned" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
      if [[ "${job_readonly}" == "on" && "${job_canmount}" != "off" ]]; then
        logger -t "${log_tag}" "Setting canmount=off on readonly recursive target tank/owned"
        zfs set canmount=off "tank/owned"
      fi
    fi
  fi

  zfs mount -a

  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Applying snapshot retention: vault/owned (60 days)"
  "${retention_script}" --source "tank/owned" --target "vault/owned" --keep-days "60" --prefix "autosnap_" --prefix "syncoid_"

  freeing_bytes=$(zpool get -Hp -o value freeing "${pool}" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [[ "${freeing_bytes}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && ${freeing_bytes} -gt 0 ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Waiting for ${freeing_bytes} bytes of asynchronous frees on ${pool}"
    zpool wait -t free "${pool}"
  fi

  if [[ -x "/usr/local/bin/zfs-syncoid-abort-partial-receive.sh" ]]; then
    "/usr/local/bin/zfs-syncoid-abort-partial-receive.sh" "tank/owned" "true"
  else
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "WARNING: abort-partial-receive script not found at /usr/local/bin/zfs-syncoid-abort-partial-receive.sh"
  fi
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Running syncoid: fast/owned -> tank/owned"
  "${syncoid_bin}" --recursive --recvoptions="o readonly=on" --force-delete --no-sync-snap --no-sync-snap fast/owned tank/owned
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Running syncoid: fast/second -> tank/second"
  "${syncoid_bin}" --no-sync-snap --no-rollback fast/second tank/second

  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Recording incremental anchors for ${label}"
  "${anchor_helper}" \
    --state-path "${anchor_state_path}" \
    --device-name "${device_names[$index]}" \
    --rotation-device "owned-a" \
    --rotation-device "owned-b" \
    --job "fast/owned" "tank/owned" "true" \
    --job "fast/second" "tank/second" "false" \
    --prune-prefix "autosnap_" \
    --prune-prefix "syncoid_" \
    

  logger -t "${log_tag}" "USB replication complete for pool ${pool} on ${label}"
}

if [[ -z "${pool}" || -z "${device_paths[0]:-}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Missing device or pool configuration; aborting."
  exit 1
fi

present=()
present_count=0
for index in "${!device_paths[@]}"; do
  if [[ -e "${device_paths[$index]}" ]]; then
    present+=("${index}")
    present_count=$((present_count + 1))
  fi
done

if [[ ${present_count} -eq 0 ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "USB device $(IFS=,; echo "${device_paths[*]}") not present; skipping replication."
  for index in "${!device_paths[@]}"; do
    if [[ -n "${device_names[$index]}" ]]; then
      write_state "skipped_absent" 0 "${index}" --device-only || true
    fi
  done
  write_state "skipped_absent" 0 ""
  exit 0
fi

for index in "${!device_paths[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -e "${device_paths[$index]}" && -n "${device_names[$index]}" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "USB device $(device_label "${index}") not present; skipping it."
    write_state "skipped_absent" 0 "${index}" --device-only || true
  fi
done

# A signal stops the loop after the running drive recorded its failure.
parent_signal=0
trap 'parent_signal=129' HUP
trap 'parent_signal=130' INT
trap 'parent_signal=143' TERM

overall_rc=0
for index in "${present[@]}"; do
  # Run each drive in its own subshell, outside any conditional context so
  # errexit (re-enabled inside) still applies, and so its EXIT trap exports
  # that drive's pool before the next drive is imported.
  set +e
  ( set -e; replicate_device "${index}" )
  rc=$?
  set -e
  if [[ ${rc} -ne 0 && ${overall_rc} -eq 0 ]]; then
    overall_rc=${rc}
  fi
  if [[ ${parent_signal} -ne 0 ]]; then
    exit "${parent_signal}"
  fi
done

if [[ ${overall_rc} -ne 0 ]]; then
  exit "${overall_rc}"
fi

if [[ "${spindown_enabled}" == "true" ]]; then
  if [[ -x "${spindown_script}" ]]; then
    "${spindown_script}" || true
  else
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Spindown script not executable: ${spindown_script}"
  fi
fi

resources.zfs-usb-spindown.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

pool="tank"
spindown_device_count=1

spindown_devices=(
  "/dev/disk/by-id/owned"
)

if [[ -n "${pool}" ]]; then
  if command -v zpool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    stats=$(zpool iostat -H -p "${pool}" 1 2 | tail -n 1 || true)
    if [[ -n "${stats}" ]]; then
      read -r _pool _alloc _free read_ops write_ops read_bytes write_bytes <<<"${stats}"
      if [[ "${read_ops:-0}" != "0" || "${write_ops:-0}" != "0" || "${read_bytes:-0}" != "0" || "${write_bytes:-0}" != "0" ]]; then
        logger -t zfs-usb-spindown "Pool ${pool} active (r=${read_ops:-0} w=${write_ops:-0} rb=${read_bytes:-0} wb=${write_bytes:-0}); skipping spindown."
        exit 0
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi

if [[ "${spindown_device_count}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  logger -t zfs-usb-spindown "No spindown devices configured; skipping."
  exit 0
fi

for dev in "${spindown_devices[@]}"; do
  if [[ -b "${dev}" ]]; then
    # Avoid redundant standby commands for already-sleeping disks.
    if command -v smartctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      smart_out="$(smartctl -n standby "${dev}" 2>&1 || true)"
      if grep -q "STANDBY mode" <<<"${smart_out}"; then
        continue
      fi
    fi
    if ! hdparm -y "${dev}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      logger -t zfs-usb-spindown "hdparm failed for ${dev}"
    fi
  else
    logger -t zfs-usb-spindown "Device ${dev} not found; skipping."
  fi
done

resources.minio-offsite-replication.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="minio-offsite-replication"
source_user="root"
source_host="owned.example"
source_path="/opt/backups/minio"
destination_path="/tank/backups/minio"
ssh_key_path="/root/.ssh/minio-offsite-replication-ed25519"
ssh_known_hosts_path="/root/.ssh/known_hosts"
ssh_connect_timeout="30"
status_file="/var/lib/minio-offsite-replication/status.json"
status_dir="/var/lib/minio-offsite-replication"
latest_marker_file="/var/lib/minio-offsite-replication/latest-archive.marker"
rsync_delete="false"
require_archives="false"
spindown_enabled="true"
spindown_script_path="/usr/local/bin/owned-spindown.sh"

ssh_bin="/usr/bin/ssh"
rsync_bin="/usr/bin/rsync"

archive_patterns=(
  "*.tar.gz"
  "*.tar.zst"
)

rsync_args=(
  "--archive"
  "--hard-links"
  "--numeric-ids"
  "--partial-dir=.rsync-partial"
)

run_spindown() {
  if [[ "${spindown_enabled}" != "true" ]]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -x "${spindown_script_path}" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Running post-sync spindown hook: ${spindown_script_path}"
    if ! "${spindown_script_path}"; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Post-sync spindown hook failed: ${spindown_script_path}"
    fi
  else
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Spindown script not executable: ${spindown_script_path}"
  fi
}

if [[ -z "${source_host}" || -z "${source_path}" || -z "${destination_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Missing required source/destination configuration."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${ssh_key_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "SSH key file not found: ${ssh_key_path}"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${ssh_known_hosts_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "known_hosts file not found: ${ssh_known_hosts_path}"
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${destination_path}" "${status_dir}"

ssh_command="${ssh_bin} -i ${ssh_key_path} -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=${ssh_known_hosts_path} -o ConnectTimeout=${ssh_connect_timeout}"

for pattern in "${archive_patterns[@]}"; do
  rsync_args+=( "--include=${pattern}" )
done
rsync_args+=( "--exclude=*" )
if [[ "${rsync_delete}" == "true" ]]; then
  rsync_args+=( "--delete" )
fi

logger -t "${log_tag}" "Syncing MinIO archives from ${source_host}:${source_path} to ${destination_path}"
"${rsync_bin}" \
  "${rsync_args[@]}" \
  -e "${ssh_command}" \
  "${source_user}@${source_host}:${source_path%/}/" \
  "${destination_path%/}/"

find_args=( "${destination_path}" -maxdepth 1 -type f "(" )
for idx in "${!archive_patterns[@]}"; do
  if [[ "${idx}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    find_args+=( "-o" )
  fi
  find_args+=( -name "${archive_patterns[$idx]}" )
done
find_args+=( ")" -printf '%T@ %p\n' )

latest_archive="$(
  {
    find "${find_args[@]}" || true
  } \
    | awk '
        BEGIN { max = -1; file = "" }
        {
          ts = $1
          $1 = ""
          sub(/^ /, "", $0)
          if (ts > max) {
            max = ts
            file = $0
          }
        }
        END {
          if (file != "") {
            print file
          }
        }
      '
)"

generated_epoch="$(date +%s)"
no_archives="false"

if [[ -z "${latest_archive}" || ! -f "${latest_archive}" ]]; then
  no_archives="true"
  latest_archive=""
  latest_epoch=""
  latest_size_bytes=""
  rm -f "${latest_marker_file}"
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "No MinIO archive found after sync under ${destination_path}"
else
  latest_epoch="$(stat -c '%Y' "${latest_archive}")"
  latest_size_bytes="$(stat -c '%s' "${latest_archive}")"
  : > "${latest_marker_file}"
  touch -d "@${latest_epoch}" "${latest_marker_file}"
fi

export STATUS_FILE="${status_file}"
export SOURCE_HOST="${source_host}"
export SOURCE_PATH="${source_path}"
export DESTINATION_PATH="${destination_path}"
export LATEST_ARCHIVE="${latest_archive}"
export LATEST_EPOCH="${latest_epoch}"
export LATEST_SIZE_BYTES="${latest_size_bytes}"
export GENERATED_EPOCH="${generated_epoch}"
export NO_ARCHIVES="${no_archives}"

python3 <<'PY'
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

status_file = os.environ["STATUS_FILE"]
generated_epoch = int(os.environ["GENERATED_EPOCH"])
latest_epoch_raw = os.environ.get("LATEST_EPOCH", "").strip()
latest_size_raw = os.environ.get("LATEST_SIZE_BYTES", "").strip()
latest_epoch = int(latest_epoch_raw) if latest_epoch_raw else None
payload = {
    "generated_at": datetime.fromtimestamp(generated_epoch, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "source_host": os.environ["SOURCE_HOST"],
    "source_path": os.environ["SOURCE_PATH"],
    "destination_path": os.environ["DESTINATION_PATH"],
    "latest_archive": os.environ.get("LATEST_ARCHIVE") or None,
    "latest_archive_mtime_epoch": latest_epoch,
    "latest_archive_mtime_iso": (
        datetime.fromtimestamp(latest_epoch, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat() if latest_epoch is not None else None
    ),
    "latest_archive_size_bytes": int(latest_size_raw) if latest_size_raw else None,
    "no_archives": os.environ.get("NO_ARCHIVES", "false").lower() == "true",
}

tmp_path = f"{status_file}.tmp"
with open(tmp_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(payload, handle, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
os.replace(tmp_path, status_file)
PY

if [[ "${no_archives}" == "true" ]]; then
  if [[ "${require_archives}" == "true" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Offsite sync failed: no archive found and require_archives=true"
    exit 1
  fi
  run_spindown
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Offsite sync completed without archives (require_archives=false)"
  exit 0
fi

run_spindown
logger -t "${log_tag}" "Offsite sync complete; latest archive=${latest_archive}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="mail-offsite-replication"
source_user="root"
source_host="owned.example"
source_vmail_path="/mnt/cryptdata/vmail"
source_stage_path="/mnt/cryptdata/mail-backup-stage"
source_stage_command="/usr/local/sbin/mail-backup-stage.sh"
destination_path="/tank/backups/mail"
destination_vmail_subdir="vmail"
destination_stage_subdir="stage"
ssh_key_path="/root/.ssh/mail-offsite-replication-ed25519"
ssh_known_hosts_path="/root/.ssh/known_hosts"
ssh_connect_timeout="30"
status_file="/var/lib/mail-offsite-replication/status.json"
status_dir="/var/lib/mail-offsite-replication"
latest_marker_file="/var/lib/mail-offsite-replication/latest-success.marker"
snapshot_enabled="true"
snapshot_dataset="tank/backups/mail"
snapshot_prefix="mail-sync"
snapshot_keep="30"
spindown_enabled="true"
spindown_script_path="/usr/local/bin/owned-spindown.sh"

ssh_bin="/usr/bin/ssh"
rsync_bin="/usr/bin/rsync"
zfs_bin="/usr/sbin/zfs"

destination_vmail_path="${destination_path%/}/${destination_vmail_subdir}"
destination_stage_path="${destination_path%/}/${destination_stage_subdir}"

vmail_rsync_args=(
  "--archive"
  "--hard-links"
  "--numeric-ids"
  "--partial-dir=.rsync-partial"
  "--delete"
)

stage_rsync_args=(
  "--archive"
  "--numeric-ids"
)

run_spindown() {
  if [[ "${spindown_enabled}" != "true" ]]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -x "${spindown_script_path}" ]]; then
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Running post-sync spindown hook: ${spindown_script_path}"
    if ! "${spindown_script_path}"; then
      logger -t "${log_tag}" "Post-sync spindown hook failed: ${spindown_script_path}"
    fi
  else
    logger -t "${log_tag}" "Spindown script not executable: ${spindown_script_path}"
  fi
}

if [[ -z "${source_host}" || -z "${source_vmail_path}" || -z "${source_stage_path}" || -z "${destination_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Missing required source/destination configuration."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${ssh_key_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "SSH key file not found: ${ssh_key_path}"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${ssh_known_hosts_path}" ]]; then
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "known_hosts file not found: ${ssh_known_hosts_path}"
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${destination_vmail_path}" "${destination_stage_path}" "${status_dir}"

ssh_command="${ssh_bin} -i ${ssh_key_path} -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=${ssh_known_hosts_path} -o ConnectTimeout=${ssh_connect_timeout}"

logger -t "${log_tag}" "Running remote pre-sync stage command on ${source_host}: ${source_stage_command}"
"${ssh_bin}" \
  -i "${ssh_key_path}" \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile="${ssh_known_hosts_path}" \
  -o ConnectTimeout="${ssh_connect_timeout}" \
  "${source_user}@${source_host}" \
  "${source_stage_command}"

logger -t "${log_tag}" "Syncing vmail from ${source_host}:${source_vmail_path} to ${destination_vmail_path}"
"${rsync_bin}" \
  "${vmail_rsync_args[@]}" \
  -e "${ssh_command}" \
  "${source_user}@${source_host}:${source_vmail_path%/}/" \
  "${destination_vmail_path%/}/"

logger -t "${log_tag}" "Syncing stage data from ${source_host}:${source_stage_path} to ${destination_stage_path}"
"${rsync_bin}" \
  "${stage_rsync_args[@]}" \
  -e "${ssh_command}" \
  "${source_user}@${source_host}:${source_stage_path%/}/" \
  "${destination_stage_path%/}/"

snapshot_name=""
if [[ "${snapshot_enabled}" == "true" ]]; then
  snapshot_name="${snapshot_dataset}@${snapshot_prefix}-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ)"
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Creating snapshot ${snapshot_name}"
  "${zfs_bin}" snapshot "${snapshot_name}"

  if [[ "${snapshot_keep}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r old_snapshot; do
      [[ -n "${old_snapshot}" ]] || continue
      "${zfs_bin}" destroy "${old_snapshot}"
    done < <(
      "${zfs_bin}" list -H -t snapshot -o name -s creation -r "${snapshot_dataset}" \
        | grep "@${snapshot_prefix}-" \
        | head -n -"${snapshot_keep}" || true
    )
  fi
fi

latest_mail_file="$(
  {
    find "${destination_vmail_path}" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' || true
  } | awk '
    BEGIN { max = -1; file = "" }
    {
      ts = $1
      $1 = ""
      sub(/^ /, "", $0)
      if (ts > max) {
        max = ts
        file = $0
      }
    }
    END {
      if (file != "") {
        print file
      }
    }
  '
)"
latest_mail_epoch=""
if [[ -n "${latest_mail_file}" && -f "${latest_mail_file}" ]]; then
  latest_mail_epoch="$(stat -c '%Y' "${latest_mail_file}")"
fi

vmail_size_bytes="$(du -sb "${destination_vmail_path}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
if [[ -z "${vmail_size_bytes}" ]]; then
  vmail_size_bytes="0"
fi

stage_manifest_path="${destination_stage_path%/}/manifest.yml"
stage_manifest_timestamp=""
if [[ -f "${stage_manifest_path}" ]]; then
  stage_manifest_timestamp="$(awk -F': ' '/^timestamp:/ {print $2}' "${stage_manifest_path}" | tail -n 1 || true)"
fi

sync_epoch="$(date +%s)"
: > "${latest_marker_file}"
touch -d "@${sync_epoch}" "${latest_marker_file}"

export STATUS_FILE="${status_file}"
export SOURCE_HOST="${source_host}"
export SOURCE_VMAIL_PATH="${source_vmail_path}"
export SOURCE_STAGE_PATH="${source_stage_path}"
export DESTINATION_PATH="${destination_path}"
export DESTINATION_VMAIL_PATH="${destination_vmail_path}"
export DESTINATION_STAGE_PATH="${destination_stage_path}"
export LATEST_MAIL_FILE="${latest_mail_file}"
export LATEST_MAIL_EPOCH="${latest_mail_epoch}"
export VMAIL_SIZE_BYTES="${vmail_size_bytes}"
export STAGE_MANIFEST_TIMESTAMP="${stage_manifest_timestamp}"
export SNAPSHOT_NAME="${snapshot_name}"
export GENERATED_EPOCH="${sync_epoch}"

python3 <<'PY'
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

status_file = os.environ["STATUS_FILE"]
generated_epoch = int(os.environ["GENERATED_EPOCH"])
latest_epoch_raw = (os.environ.get("LATEST_MAIL_EPOCH") or "").strip()
latest_epoch = int(latest_epoch_raw) if latest_epoch_raw else None

payload = {
    "generated_at": datetime.fromtimestamp(generated_epoch, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "source_host": os.environ["SOURCE_HOST"],
    "source_vmail_path": os.environ["SOURCE_VMAIL_PATH"],
    "source_stage_path": os.environ["SOURCE_STAGE_PATH"],
    "destination_path": os.environ["DESTINATION_PATH"],
    "destination_vmail_path": os.environ["DESTINATION_VMAIL_PATH"],
    "destination_stage_path": os.environ["DESTINATION_STAGE_PATH"],
    "latest_mail_file": os.environ.get("LATEST_MAIL_FILE") or None,
    "latest_mail_file_mtime_epoch": latest_epoch,
    "latest_mail_file_mtime_iso": (
        datetime.fromtimestamp(latest_epoch, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat() if latest_epoch is not None else None
    ),
    "vmail_size_bytes": int(os.environ.get("VMAIL_SIZE_BYTES") or 0),
    "stage_manifest_timestamp": os.environ.get("STAGE_MANIFEST_TIMESTAMP") or None,
    "snapshot": os.environ.get("SNAPSHOT_NAME") or None,
}

tmp_path = f"{status_file}.tmp"
with open(tmp_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(payload, handle, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
os.replace(tmp_path, status_file)
PY

run_spindown
logger -t "${log_tag}" "Mail offsite sync complete; snapshot=${snapshot_name:-none}"
